in_marathi.name: Ketan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Spark, Light, Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ketan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ketu’, meaning ‘Spark, Light, or Joy’. In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a planet representing spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name ‘Ketan’ symbolizes the illumination of one’s soul as they progress on their spiritual journey.
